title: DAOcracy
tagline: Democracy is where you go down when feels like your vote doesn't count
description:
Daocracy is based on the idea that we have to bring changes in our country with the help of DAO's .

The idea is to bring the voting system on chain in order to eradicate the notion that the offline voting machines can be hacked .
how_its_made: More than 18 hours of no proper internet connection which reduced our research time and also highly impacted our integration time. The smart contracts are ready and deployed with testing but no research was available for UI /UX.
